Our Story

A Hidden Gem in Quezon City

Tucked along a quiet street in Cubao, Greek To-Go Taverna was born from a love story — a Filipino-Greek couple sharing their passion for everything Greek with the people of Manila.

Every dish comes from old family recipes, made with fresh ingredients imported directly from Greece. From Shrimp Saganaki to Keftedes meatballs, Spanakopita and Baklava — each bite is a journey to the Mediterranean.

Available for dine-in or order via GrabFood and WhatsApp, the taverna also carries authentic imported products: extra virgin olive oil, Greek salad mix, and hand-crafted olive oil soaps.

🇬🇷
Ambassador Certified — Only in Manila Greek To-Go Taverna is the only restaurant in Metro Manila certified by the Greek Ambassador as serving authentic Greek Cuisine (all others are classified as Mediterranean).

Must-Try Dishes

Taste of Greece

Old family recipes, fresh ingredients imported directly from Greece. Every plate tells a story.

Shrimp Saganaki
A Santorini classic — shrimp in rich orange-based sauce, served with pita
Souvlaki Platter
Beef, chicken, or lamb — grilled to perfection with Greek salad & tzatziki
Watermelon & Feta Salad
A refreshing, sweet-savory Mediterranean classic
Spanakopita
Baked spinach pie layered in crispy feta-filled filo pastry
Keftedes Meatballs
Paired with tzatziki yogurt dip — a little kick every time
Baklava
Classic honey-nut pastry — sublime with a scoop of ice cream
Tzatziki Dip
Creamy yogurt with cucumber, garlic and fresh herbs
Olympus Tea
Herbal tea with Olympus flowers — the perfect end to any meal
